patterns.note: Consistent use of card-based layouts for news, updates, and research articles, often arranged in multi-column grids, providing a structured and digestible content display.
Hierarchical typography with large, bold sans-serif headings for impact, paired with a clean, readable sans-serif for body text and smaller, often uppercase, labels.
Predominantly light backgrounds and dark text, punctuated by vibrant, abstract imagery within content cards that serve as visual accents and content differentiators.

The top navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport, while the hero section features a looping background video. Content sections reveal by simply scrolling into view without complex fade-ins or slide-ins.
Dedicated 'Recent updates' and 'Latest news and experiments' sections utilize a consistent card grid pattern to showcase diverse content types, each with a thumbnail, title, and brief description.

technique_notes: A persistent top navigation bar is implemented using a sticky positioning effect, ensuring key navigation links and call-to-action buttons are always accessible as the user scrolls.
The hero section incorporates a full-bleed background video (detected as video-hero) that plays on loop, adding dynamic visual interest and setting the tone for the page.

Content sections and individual cards are designed to appear as they scroll into the viewport, using a standard scroll-reveal mechanism without complex fade-ins or slide-ups, maintaining a clean and direct content presentation.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (hero title ~4-5x body, section titles ~2-3x body) create strong hierarchy, complemented by clear, readable body text and small, often uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle. Cards, buttons, and input fields feature a consistent, slight corner rounding.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced. Generous vertical spacing between major sections and within card grids provides an airy feel, while content within cards is more compact.

standout: The site effectively balances a clean, research-oriented aesthetic with dynamic visual elements like the hero video and vibrant, abstract imagery within the content cards. The consistent card-based content display across various news and research updates, combined with a clear, hierarchical typography, makes complex information digestible and visually engaging without being overwhelming.
